bundle.shortDescription: Voice chat client compatible with Mumble (unsigned test build)
bundle.longDescription: Mumcord is a modern voice chat client compatible with Mumble. It is not affiliated with the Mumble project. This is an unsigned test build: Windows and macOS show a security warning on first launch.
